title: Electric driving range feedback
summary: Feedback on G70 driving range centers on satisfaction with available electric miles for some owners, while others report lower-than-expected range, inaccurate range estimates, or requests for more range, and many sampled fragments are too contextual or ambiguously phrased to classify cleanly.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the vehicle’s electric driving range as sufficient, very good, or excellent enough to avoid range anxiety.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on electric range falling short of expectations and on an unpredictable or inaccurate range display.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention desired or observed range figures, comparisons to other vehicles, advertised-versus-actual expectations, or contextual range statements that do not provide enough clarity for a firm sentiment label.

limitations: A large share of the sampled fragments are labeled undetermined, which limits confidence in summarizing sentiment beyond the clearly positive and negative examples.
Some undetermined examples sound favorable or unfavorable in isolation, but the provided labels require keeping them separate from explicit positive or negative sentiment.
The topic is fairly coherent around electric driving range, but several fragments are brief or highly contextual, so specific owner expectations and operating conditions are not always clear.
